source: Written 2026-10-14 from the verified Scryfall oracle text fetched that day and this deck's notes (Hero tribal; Cap before the team; Warrior's Blades and Mjolnir on Cap; counters held for wraths and engines). Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named. No base power or toughness is stated anywhere: the verified text did not include it.

scenes.head: Captain America — Team Leader
scenes.sub: Jeskai Heroes: every Hero you cast makes the team bigger, and the captain too.

scenes.head: His trigger
scenes.sub: Whenever another Hero you control enters, it gains vigilance and haste until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on that Hero and a +1/+1 counter on Captain America.

scenes.head: A Hero joins…
scenes.sub: Cast [[Falcon and Redwing]] with Cap already on the battlefield.

scenes.head: …and both grow
scenes.sub: A +1/+1 counter on Falcon and Redwing, another on Cap. Falcon gets haste and vigilance until end of turn.
scenes.say: And both grow. A plus-one counter on Falcon and Redwing, and another on Cap. Falcon gets haste and vigilance until end of turn.

scenes.head: It attacks the turn it lands
scenes.sub: Haste lets it swing right now. Vigilance means it doesn't tap, so it's still home to block.

scenes.head: Falcon connects
scenes.sub: Combat damage to a player makes that many 1/1 flying Bird tokens, then Falcon and Redwing gets another +1/+1 counter.
scenes.say: Falcon connects. Combat damage to a player makes that many one-one flying Bird tokens. Then Falcon and Redwing gets another plus-one counter.

scenes.head: Cap first. Heroes after. Attack every turn.
scenes.sub: Four clips follow: assemble the team, arm the captain, protect the clock, then win.

scenes.head: Hold your Heroes until Cap is out
scenes.sub: A Hero cast before Cap gets no counter and no haste. The same card is far better one turn later.

scenes.head: Turn 3: the captain
scenes.sub: Cap costs {R}{W}{U}. Land him first, then build the team around him.
scenes.say: Turn three: the captain. Cap costs red, white and blue. Land him first, then build the team around him.

scenes.head: Turn 4: [[Agent Phil Coulson]]
scenes.sub: Cap triggers: a +1/+1 counter on Coulson and one on Cap. Coulson gains haste and vigilance this turn.

scenes.head: [[The Wasp, Winsome Avenger|The Wasp]] joins
scenes.sub: Another counter on each. Her own trigger gives target Hero hexproof until end of turn — point it at Cap.
scenes.say: The Wasp joins. Another counter on each. Her own trigger gives target Hero hexproof until end of turn. Point it at Cap.

scenes.head: Haste lets Coulson tap right away
scenes.sub: [[Agent Phil Coulson|Coulson]]: put a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control. Cap now has three counters, The Wasp two.

scenes.head: Then attack
scenes.sub: Whenever The Wasp attacks, tap target creature the defending player controls. Their best blocker sits out.

scenes.head: Card draw rides along
scenes.sub: [[Jarvis, Earth's Mightiest Butler|Jarvis]] draws whenever you cast a Hero spell. [[Kindred Discovery]], naming Hero, draws whenever one enters or attacks.

scenes.head: Cheaper Heroes, bigger Heroes
scenes.sub: [[Director Nick Fury]]: Hero spells cost {1} less, and each attack looks at four cards for another. [[Metallic Mimic]], naming Hero: other Heroes enter with an extra +1/+1 counter.
scenes.say: Cheaper Heroes, bigger Heroes. [[Director Nick Fury]] makes Hero spells cost one less, and each time you attack he looks at the top four cards for another Hero. [[Metallic Mimic]], naming Hero, makes each other Hero enter with an extra plus-one counter.

scenes.head: [[Warrior's Blades]]
scenes.sub: It enters dealing 3 damage to any target, and you gain 3 life. Their small creature is gone.

scenes.head: Equip for free
scenes.sub: Equip {3} costs {1} less for each +1/+1 counter on the target. Cap has three, so it costs nothing. He gets +2/+1.
scenes.say: Equip for free. Equip costs three, minus one for each plus-one counter on the creature. Cap has three, so it costs nothing, and he gets plus two plus one.

scenes.head: [[Mjölnir, Hammer of Thor]]
scenes.sub: It enters dealing 4 damage to up to one target creature. And it doubles all damage the equipped creature would deal.

scenes.head: Equip worthy {1}
scenes.sub: Worthy means a legendary non-Villain that's red and/or white. Cap is legendary, red and white, and a Hero, so he qualifies.
scenes.say: Equip worthy, for one. Worthy means a legendary creature that's red or white, and not a Villain. Cap is legendary, red and white, and a Hero, so he qualifies.

scenes.head: Every hit counts double
scenes.sub: Equipped, Cap deals double damage, and his combat damage to a player is commander damage. 21 of it knocks them out.
scenes.say: Every hit counts double. Equipped, Cap deals double damage, and his combat damage to a player is commander damage. Twenty-one of it knocks that player out.

scenes.head: [[Thor, Asgard's Avenger|Thor]] adds one
scenes.sub: Your other sources deal 1 more damage to opponents and their permanents: Mjölnir's 4 to their creature becomes 5. Thor is worthy too.
scenes.say: Thor adds one. Your other sources deal one more damage to opponents and their permanents, so Mjölnir's four damage to their creature becomes five. Thor is worthy too: a backup carrier for the hammer.

scenes.head: Last resort: discard Mjölnir
scenes.sub: {2}{R}, discard it from your hand: 2 damage to each creature, yours included.
scenes.say: Last resort: discard Mjölnir. Pay two and red, and discard it from your hand: it deals two damage to each creature, yours included.

scenes.head: [[Solitary Cell]]
scenes.sub: It enters and exiles target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value 3 or less…
scenes.say: [[Solitary Cell]]. It enters and exiles target nonland permanent an opponent controls with mana value three or less.

scenes.head: …until the Cell leaves
scenes.sub: Later: {1}, tap it, discard a legendary card: draw a card. Almost every creature in this deck is legendary.
scenes.say: Until the Cell leaves the battlefield. Later, pay one, tap it, and discard a legendary card to draw a card. Almost every creature in this deck is legendary.

scenes.head: Cheap removal
scenes.sub: [[Swords to Plowshares]] exiles a creature for {W}. [[Abrade]] and [[Rip Apart]] deal 3 damage to a creature or destroy an artifact. [[Dispatch]] exiles one with three artifacts out.
scenes.say: Cheap removal. [[Swords to Plowshares]] exiles a creature for one white. [[Abrade]] and [[Rip Apart]] deal three damage to a creature, or destroy an artifact. [[Dispatch]] exiles a creature if you control three or more artifacts.

scenes.head: Hold up a counterspell
scenes.sub: [[Counterspell]], [[Force of Will]], [[Memory Lapse]], [[Essence Scatter]], [[Arcane Denial]]. Save them for wraths and the table's engine, not the first threat you see.

scenes.head: A wrath is coming…
scenes.sub: Destroy all creatures.

scenes.head: …sacrifice [[Spectacular Spider-Man]]
scenes.sub: {1}, sacrifice him: creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. He has flash, so he can arrive in response.
scenes.say: Sacrifice [[Spectacular Spider-Man]]. Pay one and sacrifice him: creatures you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. He has flash, so he can arrive in response.

scenes.head: [[Kid Loki]] hides the new team
scenes.sub: Each creature you've put a +1/+1 counter on this turn has hexproof. On a turn you add Heroes, they and Cap all qualify.

scenes.head: Flash in [[Rescue, Pepper Potts|Rescue]]
scenes.sub: Removal aimed at a Hero? Rescue returns it to your hand, and she's a Hero, so Cap triggers. Recast the saved one for another trigger.

scenes.head: The winning attack
scenes.sub: Cap wears both equipment and a pile of counters. Every Hero that entered under him has a counter too.

scenes.head: [[War Machine, Avenging Arsenal|War Machine]] attacks
scenes.sub: Attacking modified creatures you control gain double strike. Counters and Equipment are modifications, so every Hero with a counter qualifies.

scenes.head: [[Firebird, Blazing Ranger|Firebird]] attacks
scenes.sub: Other attacking creatures get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is Firebird's power.
scenes.say: Firebird attacks. Other attacking creatures get plus X power until end of turn, where X is Firebird's power.

scenes.head: Four times his power
scenes.sub: Double strike hits twice, and Mjölnir doubles each hit. At power 6, one unblocked swing is 24 commander damage, past 21.
scenes.say: Four times his power. Double strike hits twice, and Mjölnir doubles each hit. At power six, one unblocked swing is twenty-four commander damage. That's past twenty-one.

scenes.head: Get through the blockers
scenes.sub: [[She-Hulk, Wallbreaker|She-Hulk]] gives your other Heroes trample. [[Iron Man, Armored Avenger|Iron Man]] gives other attacking modified creatures flying. [[The Wasp, Winsome Avenger|The Wasp]] taps a blocker.

scenes.head: Or go wide
scenes.sub: [[Captain America, Wings of Freedom]] attacks: each other Hero gets +X/+X, X being his toughness. [[Avengers Assemble!]] gives Heroes +2/+2.
scenes.say: Or go wide. When [[Captain America, Wings of Freedom]] attacks, each other Hero you control gets plus X plus X, where X is his toughness. [[Avengers Assemble!]] gives your Heroes plus two plus two.

scenes.head: Wiped? Rebuild.
scenes.sub: [[Avengers Quinjet]] returns a Hero card from your graveyard to your hand. [[Winter Soldier, Reborn Avenger|Winter Soldier]] attacks and returns a creature card with mana value up to his power to the battlefield.
scenes.say: Wiped? Rebuild. When [[Avengers Quinjet]] enters or attacks, it can return a Hero card from your graveyard to your hand. Whenever [[Winter Soldier, Reborn Avenger|Winter Soldier]] attacks, he returns a creature card with mana value up to his power from your graveyard to the battlefield.

scenes.head: Captain America — Team Leader
scenes.sub: Cap first, Heroes after, attack every turn. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
